title: Copilot draft PR handoff: publish-to-ready lives in copilot-agent.yml, and copilot-review.yml only reacts to already-ready PRs
answers: Which workflow marks a Copilot agent draft PR as ready for review?
Why does the Copilot review workflow skip draft PRs?
Where is the review_requested event for a Copilot PR handled now?
body:
Path: Two workflows split the Copilot agent PR flow. .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft reacts to pull_request_target review_requested on a draft PR opened by the Copilot bot and marks it ready. .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml:request-review reacts to opened and ready_for_review on non-draft PRs from OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR authors or from the Copilot bot, and requests a Copilot review.
Rule: Keep ready-for-review logic out of copilot-review.yml. Its trigger list is opened and ready_for_review, and the handoff between the two workflows is the ready_for_review event emitted by copilot-agent.yml. If the Copilot draft trigger changes, edit the if-condition in copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft and the draft == false guard in copilot-review.yml:request-review together.
Constraints: copilot-review.yml skips every draft PR, so a draft Copilot PR gets a review only after publish-draft runs. The handoff depends on the app token rule in the other notes for this flow.
applies: Applies to the Copilot agent PR workflows in .github/workflows/; not to other review or labeling workflows.
says: Why does the automated code review skip draft pull requests opened by our bot?
Draft pull requests from the coding bot are never marked ready for review.
Requesting review on a bot draft pull request should automatically make it ready.
Automated reviews fail to run on newly submitted draft pull requests.
Ensure draft pull requests get published before automated review requests are triggered.
search: Copilot agent draft PR handoff splits between .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft, which marks draft PRs ready on review_requested, and .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml:request-review, which triggers only on opened and ready_for_review. Ready-for-review logic must stay out of copilot-review.yml, which skips all draft PRs. Changes to draft triggers require updating the if-condition in publish-draft and the draft == false guard in copilot-review.yml together. This applies strictly to Copilot agent workflows in .github/workflows/.
